ledger_excerpt:
From Los Angeles Municipal Code § 11.00(m):
"It shall be unlawful for any person to violate any provision or fail to comply with any of the requirements of this Code... Any person convicted of a misdemeanor under the provisions of this Code, unless provision is otherwise made herein, shall be punishable by a fine of not more than $1,000.00 or by imprisonment in the County Jail for a period of not more than six (6) months, or by both fine and imprisonment... Each person shall be guilty of a separate offense for each and every day during any portion of which any violation of any provision of this Code is committed, continued or permitted..."   \
From Los Angeles Municipal Code § 12.21:
Establishes general zoning requirements, area standards, and residential/hillside setback limitations (e.g., LAMC § 12.21 C.10), with enforcement and statutory penal consequences flowing through the general penalty framework of the Code.
